lines: (Bruno nods at you from under his beanie.) 'Sup. Bruno. Nina's brother. You skate?
Cool. Big Vert. Later. Don't chicken out.
(He's lining up the Big Vert.) Watch. And don't film it if I fall.
My room. Posters. Board. Ramp. Mum says no ramps indoors. It's a small ramp.

rotate: The gap jump? Seven metres. I've cleared it. Twice. Okay, once and a half.
Juniper keeps trying to interview me. No comment.
Nina goes quiet near midnight. Like she's listening for something. Weird, right? ...Right?
